changes.title: Polish pass from the running app: tabs, phone tables, buttons
changes.detail:
The Home Assistant pages were opened in a running copy of build 115 (the published container image) at 1440 and 390 pixels wide, and these defects fixed:

- The page tab strip fades out at an edge that has tabs scrolled out of view, instead of cutting the last tab's name in half ("Set"). - On a phone, data table rows grow with their stacked columns. Before, a second line spilled into the next row (users, blueprints). - The Personal settings info buttons asked the translation for "About {name}" without a name, which logged a formatting error on every render (52 times on one visit). The placeholder is now passed through for the button to fill in. - The scenes empty state's "Learn more" icon was drawn at 80 pixels, because the large empty-state icon style reached into the button. - The to-do list's Add item button sat behind the page footer on wide layouts.

changes.title: Deploy Assistant polish pass over every board
changes.detail:
Every board was drawn again from the app, reviewed, and these fixed:

- The Deploy tab has the same header as every other tab: icon, title, one line on what it does, version and demo tags on the right. - Instances, Downloads and Extensions put their main buttons in the header instead of on a row of their own under it. - Instance cards say "1 backup", not "1 backups". - The new Minecraft server dialog no longer cuts its step names: the current step is named, the others show their number. - The demo has game rules, so the Game rules tab is not empty. - AI models: memory and graphics memory join the header facts instead of a second row repeating them; the folded system prompt shows a chevron and whether it is set; the number steppers have real buttons. The steppers' class no longer clashes with the wizard steps. - Activity spaces its Notifications and History headings apart. - The update self-test demo names the current version, not 1.1.4. - The Design tab includes every Deploy Assistant canvas, 16 to 20. - Search fields show one focus ring, on the rounded edge. - The virtual disk file and parent fields span the dialog. - The empty convert result says "Results show here."
